__comment: Reference copy of the trust policy for insolvia-shared-deploy-role. The authoritative definition is data.aws_iam_policy_document.github_assume in infra/envs/ci-trust/main.tf, applied by a human, never CI. Two repositories assume the role, insolvia and insolvia-services, each in both subject forms: the immutable numeric-id form the org enforces (repo:<org>@<org_id>/<repo>@<repo_id>, see infra/envs/ci-trust/variables.tf) and the mutable owner/name form. The org login is lowercase. Replace <ACCOUNT_ID> before manual use.
